title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_garden_of_thorns_by_amber_mitchell_01wxc (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_garden_of_thorns_by_amber_mitchell_01wxc' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removing the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
